source_map.單機世界倖存者數量。低/中/高為性能預設；自訂用下方數字。重新開始或本局內會增刪: The number of survivors in the stand-alone world. Low/Medium/High is the performance default; customize with the numbers below. Starting over or adding or deleting instances in this bureau.

source_map.按合法活動面積計算目標人口時的基礎密度。: Base density when calculating the target population by area of legal activity.
source_map.工業區域目標人口乘數。: The target population multiplier for the industrial zone.

source_map.郊區區域目標人口乘數。: Target population multiplier for suburban areas.
source_map.單個區域目標人口上限。: The maximum target population for a single area.
source_map.每輪最多實例化的殭屍數。: Maximum number of instantiated zombies per round.

source_map.低=性能；中=SSAO/Bloom；高=城市可用SSR+體積霧；極致=SSIL/: Low = performance; Medium = SSAO/Bloom; High = city usable SSR + volume fog; Extreme = SSIL/SDFGI (SDFGI anti-display memory blasting is still prohibited by default in large cities).

source_map.SDFGI 體積 GI；極致檔可用，大型 static_map 城市場景預設關閉: SDFGI Volume GI; Extreme file available, large static_map city scenes are turned off by default to prevent 2GB graphics card OOM.
